name: Adolf Rosenberger
features: fair skin, dark hair combed straight back, alert dark eyes, oval face, high forehead, slim medium build, precise businesslike expression
bio: A Mercedes privateer with wins at Avus, Solitude and the Klausenpass who survived the 1926 German Grand Prix crash that killed three men beside the track. In 1931 he put up the money that founded Ferdinand Porsche’s design bureau and argued the Auto Union Grand Prix car into its mid-engined layout. As a Jew he was forced out of the firm in 1935, briefly imprisoned, and emigrated; he died in California in 1967.
